summary: 45-day to 12-month internship or project-trainee work at ISRO's Indian Institute of Remote Sensing, Dehradun (remote sensing, GIS, geoinformatics).
eligibility: Indian citizens in UG/PG/PhD science or technology programmes with at least 60% or 6.32/10 CGPA; college NOC needed.
title: ISRO-IIRS External Student Internship / Project Trainee (Oct 2026 round)

prize.description: No stipend or accommodation; certificate on completion.

notes: IIRS takes applications twice a year (31 March and 31 October); one aggregator lists 30 Oct, so apply a day early.
Next round after this one: 31 March 2027.
